items.title: Collect Pre-War Money
items.detail: Loot cash registers and safes at Camden Park or Wavy Willard's Water Park

items.title: Collect a Lighter, Cigarette or Cigar
items.detail: Use Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine at C.A.M.P. or another player's camp if available

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Masked cultists appear in Daily Ops during the Slasher event; kill counts when they go down

items.title: Scrap Pre-War Money
items.detail: Collect Pre-War Money from cash registers and safes, then scrap it at a workbench

items.title: Collect a box of Fancy Lads Snack Cakes
Kill a Lost during the "Mischief Night" Event
Drink Tea
items.detail: Use Company Tea generator at C.A.M.P. to collect and drink tea quickly

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Fast travel to Blackwater Mine for reliable spawn; target head with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation while on a Team!
items.detail: Join any team (can be solo team); Phantoms appear in Daily Ops during Slasher event

items.title: Kill a Rusted Deathclaw
items.detail: Fast travel to Dino Peaks Mini Golf for 3 spawns; target belly with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at Tinker's Workbench, then scrap it

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Antiseptic
items.detail: Scrap Abraxo cleaner, Industrial solvent, Turpentine, or Tick blood sacs at workbench

items.title: Sell Mirelurk Queen Steak to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Mirelurk Queens spawn at Mac's Farm or Spruce Knob Lake; sell steak to any vendor

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint on foot without fast traveling; keep weapon holstered for faster movement

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six daily challenges on three separate days to earn the weekly Gold Star

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Community event challenging players to build themed C.A.M.P.s inspired by the Slasher seasonal event.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Limited-time seasonal event featuring Lost enemies and Pint-Sized Phantom Daily Operations with unique rewards.

events.name: Minerva's Big Sale (List 4) and Gold Rush
events.description: Vendor Minerva offers discounted plans and legendary crafting materials; Gold Rush event runs concurrently.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Increased mutation rates across Appalachia; Daily Operations feature new seasonal rewards.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Holiday-themed event spawning Spooky Scorched enemies with exclusive cosmetic and weapon rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Weekend event doubling all experience gains for faster character leveling and progression.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish; new Local Legend and recipes available during the event.
